purpose: Versioned app-consumable reference evidence for the18 owner-roadmap requirements; not a conformity certificate, legal applicability opinion or exhaustive implementation of ESKD.

coverage.rule_scope: Selected independently readable numerical/semantic constraints, not all clauses.
coverage.primary_metadata: All18 owner entries plus individually checked RF successors and withdrawal events.
coverage.authoritative_full_text: 20 accessed primary manifests returned empty page arrays; ГОСТ Р2.503-2023 listed36 pages but the requested page displayed an authorization-required image.
coverage.copyright: No full-text standards, document page images or downloaded PDFs are included; only original structured factual summaries, short evidence quotes and links.

consumer_contract.stable_standard_ids: IDs identify owner-required standard families; preserve interstate IDs when RF successors differ.
consumer_contract.date_format: ISO8601 calendar date; null means unknown/not recorded, never guessed.
consumer_contract.time_intervals: from inclusive, until exclusive; evaluated as of researched_at, not a future status assertion.
consumer_contract.rule_applicability: Use each rule.applies_to designation, not only its parent entry. Rules under withdrawn interstate entries may explicitly apply to the RF successor.

verification_statuses.primary_metadata_verified: Designation/status/date/order was read on an official Rosstandart card; not full-text verification.
verification_statuses.secondary_text_verified_primary_text_una: Rule was transcribed from cited secondary text/figure; comparison with an authorized authoritative edition and all amendments remains required.

normativity.shall: Requirement in the selected text, subject to its clause scope and exceptions.
normativity.should: Recommendation; must not automatically become a mandatory failure.
normativity.may: Conditional permission, not a mandatory preset.
normativity.not_regulated: The cited standard explicitly does not fix this value.

consumer_contract.parameters: Numbers are nominal paper-space mm unless the rule explicitly says otherwise. Approximate ratios are not exact acceptance tolerances.
consumer_contract.reference_not_validator: Presence in this file does not mean a checker, geometry generator or renderer implements the rule. Do not automatically enforce unreviewed secondary rules as certified failures.
consumer_contract.current_profile_selection: default_rf_designation is metadata as of research date, not a claim that existing presets implement that designation. Future2026 RF editions require explicit early-adoption selection until2027-10-01.

working_presets.interpretation: These are optional working selections, not universal mandatory values.7mm baseline spacing and2mm protrusion lie within cited dimension requirements;3.5mm arrows/text and1mm gap are not asserted to be universally required.

access_limitations.requirement: Anonymous metadata access succeeded; public viewers either returned no pages or an authorization-required placeholder. An authorized normative reviewer must verify complete authoritative text and amendment substance. No access-control bypass was attempted.
Secondary HTML may carry old publication headers or omit recent corrigenda. Per-standard discrepancies and manual_review are part of the data, not suppressed warnings.
Only Russian applicability was investigated. Do not infer current validity in other adopting states from a Russian card.
A dated snapshot cannot prove that no subsequent amendment exists. Refresh authoritative metadata when changing profiles or releasing compliance-sensitive features.
